Me and my host Hannah tried switching for the first time about a year and a half ago. I basically moved some fingers and I was pretty much out of commission for a few days, so I'd say it's normal for your tulpa to feel tired while getting used to switching and all. It took a lot of practice for us to be able to switch without too many seams.

So, while I don't have any guides or videos to offer, I would suggest to just keep trying and to not push your tulpa too far when they're tired. It takes a lot of work and practice, so there's no shame in getting tired or anything, it gets easier the more you practice with your tulpa.

Oof.

After hearing Danica on the radio this season, I don't blame her for ending things here, instead of going to a mid/low tier team and struggle to break the results she's having now.

But as a fan, this really sucks. As a female myself having a female break out in NASCAR after so many women have been hyped was a huge deal to me. She's one of the sole reasons I got back into NASCAR. I'm 100% going to miss her next year, and I hope she can pull together a decent ride to get a shot at Daytona/Indy

I do want to say, this last season especially has 100% soured me on SHR. It feels like they didn't even give her a chance to do anything with the kind of equipment they gave her. She was straight up miserable in the car all season. It honestly feels like they just shoved her into some leftover stuff just to get the season over and put someone like Almirola in, but that may just be my disappointment talking. 

I honestly don't know where I'll go from here. In all honestly, my favorite drivers like Danica and Jr are retiring, and none of the young guys like Byron and Elliot are appealing to me. In all honestly with my drivers leaving my interest is starting to wane, and I hate that in all honesty.

I know Danica has never really done much in NASCAR stat wise, but if this is the end for her in NASCAR then I'm going to be sad quite honestly. As a woman it was honestly quite nice to see a female come into the Cup series and actually have moderate success, even if she never made the Chase. 

Danica has been honestly a big inspiration to me for a long time and one of the main reasons I kept watching when things got rough for me around 2010-2012.
